description: An own iOS app's App Store reviews (synced from App Store Connect every 5 minutes) with their reply state: the AI draft or your text, English translations of non-English reviews and drafts, hold reasons (needs_human, quota, daily_cap), schedule time, and any live App Store response. Newest first, with per-status counts. Use the review `id` with sonar_update_review_reply / sonar_post_review_reply. Requires an Indie plan (trial counts), App Store Connect connected in Sonar, and the app to be one of your own iOS apps.

app_id.description: Sonar app UUID of one of your own iOS apps (an `id` from sonar_list_apps). NOT a store id.

country.description: Only reviews from this storefront (ISO alpha-2).

rating.description: Only reviews with this star rating.

status.description: needs_reply = no reply yet (incl. AI drafts waiting for approval, held and failed ones), scheduled = will post soon, replied = live or waiting for Apple (incl. replies made in App Store Connect), dismissed. Omit for all.

name: sonar_review_inbox
title: Review Inbox
